description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for Task API operations, including create, update, and response data structures.

classes.name: TaskDtos
classes.description: A container class for various DTOs related to Task API operations.

classes.name: CreateTaskRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new task, including title, optional description, and due date.

classes.name: UpdateTaskRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing task, allowing modification of title, description, completion status, and due date.

classes.name: TaskResponse
classes.description: DTO representing task data exposed via the API, including identification, status, timestamps, and due date.

methods.name: Getters and setters for each field in all DTO classes
methods.description: Standard accessor and mutator methods for data fields in CreateTaskRequest, UpdateTaskRequest, and TaskResponse.
